notes: The UI wordmark reads clover, the app's in-product name; it shows in the showcase, split, stack and mosaic frames, not in the focused ones.
Every capture comes from one session with the page clock held at 17:20, so all timers agree (1:33 under anesthesia, next reading in 3:44).
One reading was recorded first so Knuckles is not shown overdue; the dose (22 mg/kg) and the sign-off box are typed or ticked, not saved.
Milo's recovery timer reads 0:55 on Today and 0:54 on the Patients cards at the same clock: the app rounds the two views differently.
Showcase, stack and mosaic frames show whole screens at a third to a half of their size, so their UI text is below 10 px at 1x.
Patient photos are the app's bundled fictional AI-generated portraits; there are no real people.
